beats.care: Before paying fees anywhere, check the college's affiliation on the university website.
beats.what: SPPU's affiliation cell issued a notice telling students to avoid the Synergy School of Commerce for 2026-27.
beats.why: A student complained she couldn't get her transfer certificate. An SPPU committee then found the college missing from its address.

cards.body: Officials couldn't reach the college by phone, so SPPU sent an inquiry committee. It has filed complaints with Maharashtra's DTE and AICTE.
SPPU called admitting students without affiliation and moving without approval "unauthorised practices."

cards.q: Did you check affiliation before joining college?

opts: Verify its affiliation with the university
Pay fees early to lock a seat
cards.q: What is the safest step before joining a private college?
cards.why: SPPU urged students to confirm affiliation status first to avoid academic trouble.

hook: How did a student's *missing TC* expose a Pune college?

learn.t: SPPU's inquiry found the college was not running at its registered address and had moved without approval.

sources.name: Pune Pulse
sources.title: Pune: SPPU Flags Synergy School Of Commerce Over Lack Of Affiliation, Urges Students To Avoid Admissions

tldr: SPPU has told students not to take admission at Synergy School of Commerce, saying it is not affiliated with the university.
